## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The home containment check must be fixed before merge because parent traversal and symlinks allow previews outside the selected directory. Tests were read, not run.

## Changes
Adds a file preview limited to 200 characters, a settings-file path helper, and tests for previews, outside absolute paths, and settings paths.

## Critical
- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — Resolve paths before checking home containment — With `home=/srv/home` and `relative=../secret.txt`, `preview` reads `/srv/secret.txt` instead of rejecting it. `is_relative_to` checks lexical ancestry without resolving parent components or symlinks, so outward-pointing symlinks also bypass this check. — Parent traversal or an outward-pointing symlink lets callers read the first 200 characters of files outside the selected home. — Fix: Resolve both paths before checking containment, and extend `test_preview` with parent-traversal and outward-symlink cases.
